name: How can you help me?
format: Return your explanation as a JSON string.

name: Covered cancers
prompt: List every cancer indication covered by the dataset as a JSON array of strings.

name: Lung targets
prompt: What are the main genes involved in lung cancer?
format: Return the gene symbols from the dataset as a JSON array of strings.

name: Breast cancer expressions
prompt: What is the median value expression of genes involved in breast cancer?
format: Return a JSON object mapping gene symbols to the values returned by the expression tool.

name: Esophageal cancer is not covered
prompt: What is the median value expression of genes involved in esophageal cancer?
format: Return a JSON object with covered (whether this cancer is in the dataset) and expressions (a gene-to-value object, empty when no data is available).

name: Canonical alias
prompt: What is the canonical symbol for HER2 in the dataset? Return a JSON string.

name: Lung expressions (two tools)
prompt: Find the targets for lung cancer, then get their expression values using get_expressions. Return a JSON object mapping gene symbols to those values.

name: Unknown gene
prompt: Look up the canonical symbol for NOT_A_GENE. Return JSON null if it is not in the dataset.
